source_text: 本次合成任务采用已验证案例 valid-local-inbox；各字段以该案例的公开输入为准，不追加资料外事实。

review_checks: 核对所有事实能在输入资料或已接受引用中找到。
核对输出满足 Turn a product idea into a capability ledger, workflow, requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
缺失或未确认信息必须明确标注；不得新增授权、执行或生产完成声明。

inputs.current_workflow: Fictional user diary: checks 6 apps every 20 minutes; fears missing urgent messages, so keeps all notifications on.
inputs.idea: A local-first inbox that batches low-priority notifications into two daily digests

review_checks: 缺少必填字段 constraints，必须补齐后再确认。
